Intake
DJ Service

The Fam Jam Sound

Not a playlist. An actual DJ set built around your party.

You tell us what you want to hear - favorite artists, must-plays, genres to avoid - and we build around it. We go through your wishlist before the event, then read the room and adjust on the fly.

We've pulled off 80s rock, emo, showtunes, and 90s pop in the same night. We've also started a set as a rave and switched to indie rock halfway through because that's where the crowd wanted to go. Whatever you bring us, we'll make it work.

  • Three DJs rotating through every event
  • Pioneer XDJ-AZ system + table, brought and set up by us
  • JBL PartyBox 310 - more than enough for most events (larger PA rental available for bigger venues)
  • Fog machine + lasers and lights for night events (full lighting package available if you want to go bigger)
  • Microphone on-hand for speeches and toasts
  • Day-of announcing and scripting included

Tell us the moments that matter. We'll make sure they land.

Day-of Scripting - Included

Have moments you don't want to miss? Share your timeline and we'll work them in. We can follow your script or help you build one - either way, we keep things moving so you're not watching the clock.

DJ Service Plan
Meet the Crew

Fam Jam Collective

Three DJs. Rotating styles. One vibe tailored to your crowd (kid-appropriate cool).

We're three parents of kids under 5 who all met at Lightning in a Bottle music festival. Since then, we've spent our weekends hosting family-friendly parties in backyards and DJing in living rooms — keeping the good times going while still being home for bedtime. We love music, we love a good party, and we've gotten very good at reading a room that has both a grandma and a toddler in it.
